column1: # GoogleSQL token forms for generated compat rows: the text written for each
# token GoogleSQL.g4 names, a class of texts or a token the tokenizer makes
# in code (its lookahead transformer, from the words around it). Keywords and
# punctuation spell themselves and need no row. Each note cites the token in
# googlesql.tm, whose lexer matches keywords in any case (caseInsensitive).

column3: googlesql.tm:205 a letter or _, then letters, digits and _; or a backquoted name
googlesql.tm:201 a quoted string, raw (r) or triple-quoted
googlesql.tm:202 b or rb and a quoted string
googlesql.tm:203 decimal or hex (0x) digits, which the lookahead transformer makes from DECIMAL_INTEGER_LITERAL and HEX_INTEGER_LITERAL
googlesql.tm:204 digits with a point or an exponent, fused by the lookahead transformer
googlesql.tm:212 a name the tokenizer reads as a label, before : at the start of a statement
googlesql.tm:775 any token in the body of DEFINE MACRO
googlesql.tm:506 a name against a number (10K); its only alternative refuses it
googlesql.tm:251 the @ that opens a hint, @{
googlesql.tm:255 the @ of an integer hint, @1
googlesql.tm:257 the @ of an integer hint before a @{ hint
googlesql.tm:466 NOT before BETWEEN, IN, LIKE or DISTINCT
googlesql.tm:311 DEFINE first in a statement
googlesql.tm:326 GRAPH_TABLE where the language enables it as a reserved word
googlesql.tm:395 QUALIFY where the language enables it as a reserved word
googlesql.tm:344 MATCH_RECOGNIZE where the language enables it as a reserved word
googlesql.tm:453 WITH before ( that opens a WITH expression
googlesql.tm:454 EXCEPT between two queries
googlesql.tm:456 FOR before UPDATE that ends a query
googlesql.tm:457 FULL before a set operation
googlesql.tm:458 INNER before a set operation
googlesql.tm:459 LEFT before a set operation
googlesql.tm:460 TABLE in a FROM-less table clause
googlesql.tm:461 REPLACE after INSERT OR
googlesql.tm:462 UPDATE after INSERT OR
googlesql.tm:502 OPTIONS in SELECT WITH a OPTIONS(...)
